logline: A villager kid tries for 900 days to get the dog on the hill to stand up, until the one person it obeys logs back in.
question: why tf has the dog sat on that hill for 900 days?
premise: A tamed wolf has sat on one hilltop block above the village for 900 days, staring at an empty patch of grass beside an old dirt hut. Bones pile up untouched. A villager kid decides to sit with him so he doesn't wait alone.
twist: A sitting dog only stands for its owner, and its owner is a player who logged out on that patch 900 days ago (players come back where they left). 'Buh joined the game': he appears on the patch and the dog stands for the first time. He says 'Sit, boy. I'll be right back.' and logs out again. The dog sits. Day one.

lines.text: The DOG / on the HILL / hasn't MOVED / in nine-hundred / DAYS.

lines.text: Not for RAIN. / Not for THUNDER. / Not for CREEPERS. / Not even ZOMBIES.
lines.say: Not for RAIN. Not for THUNDER. Not for CREEPERS. Not even ZOMBIES.

lines.text: Kids THROW / STICKS for him. / He doesn't BLINK.
lines.say: Kids throw STICKS for him. He doesn't BLINK.

lines.text: So every MORNING, / I BRING him / a BONE. / He never LOOKS.
lines.say: So every morning, I bring him a BONE. He never LOOKS.

lines.text: He's GOT / a red COLLAR. / But NOBODY here / OWNS him.
lines.say: He's got a red COLLAR. But nobody here OWNS him.

lines.text: He just STARES / at one EMPTY / patch of GRASS. / Maybe he LIKES / the GRASS.
lines.say: He just stares at one empty patch of GRASS. Maybe he likes the GRASS.

lines.text: And BEHIND him, / an OLD / dirt HUT. / Nobody KNOWS / who BUILT it.
lines.say: And behind him, an old dirt HUT. Nobody knows who BUILT it.

lines.text: I ASKED him / to STAND. / I even BEGGED.
lines.say: I asked him to STAND. I even BEGGED.

lines.text: Only ONE voice / gets him UP.
lines.say: Only one voice gets him UP.

lines.text: So every NIGHT, / I SIT there. / NOBODY should / wait ALONE.
lines.say: So every night, I SIT there. Nobody should wait ALONE.

lines.text: Then last NIGHT, / he STOOD up.
lines.say: Then last night, he STOOD up.

lines.text: A GUY / just APPEARED / on the PATCH.
lines.say: A guy just appeared on the PATCH.
